title: Realization of a finite-presentation affine sections model
statement: Let X and Y be affine schemes and g : Y → X a morphism (def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions). Let P be a quasi-coherent module on Y (pqf-def-coherent), and Q a finitely presented module over Γ(X, top). Assume a supplied isomorphism from scalar extension of Q along g.appTop to Γ(P, top), as Γ(Y, top)-modules. There is a finitely presented quasi-coherent module N on X with g-pullback N isomorphic to P (def-pc-base-change). The input Q and the supplied sections isomorphism determine the construction; there is no inverse-limit hypothesis or choice of a finite stage.

source.place: Section 26.7, Tag 01I6, Lemmas 26.7.1, 26.7.3 and 26.7.4; finite global presentation argument; also Limits Tag 01ZR affine proof

proof.text:
Transport Q to Spec of the global-section ring of X and take its associated
quasi-coherent sheaf; pull it back along the canonical isomorphism X to that
spectrum. A finite presentation of Q gives a finite global presentation of the
associated sheaf, so it is finitely presented. The affine pullback/tensor comparison
identifies the sections of its pullback along g with scalar extension of Q.
Compose this with e. Both sheaves on Y are quasi-coherent, hence the affine module
equivalence lifts that section isomorphism to an isomorphism of sheaves. The
construction uses Q itself and its associated sheaf, not an arbitrary witness of
existence. Empty affine schemes and zero modules follow from the same equivalence.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01I6 affine module equivalence and pullback/tensor comparison

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finitePresentation_affine_sections_realization
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y] (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (P : Y.Modules) (hPq : P.IsQuasicoherent)
    (Q : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤)) (hQ : Module.FinitePresentation Γ(X, ⊤) Q)
    (e : Nonempty ((ModuleCat.extendScalars g.appTop.hom).obj Q ≅
      ModuleCat.of Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(P, ⊤))) :
    ∃ N : X.Modules, N.IsFinitePresentation ∧ N.IsQuasicoherent ∧
      Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N ≅ P)
